title: Concept: Yarn whitelists a host for unencrypted traffic
description: .yarnrc.yml declares a host on the `unsafeHttpWhitelist`, which Yarn will talk to over cleartext, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Every package fetched from a whitelisted host forgoes transport authentication, so its bytes can be replaced in flight.
risk: Every package fetched from a whitelisted host forgoes transport authentication, so its bytes can be replaced in flight.
